items.editor_note: NVIDIA's blog on three ways to boost MoE inference on a single DGX Spark.

editorial.tldr: NVIDIA introduced RTX Spark in October as a superchip for PCs with up to 128GB of unified memory, and by Oct 28 RTX Spark laptops were shipping from six OEMs. In the same window, vLLM's CI began tracking DGX Spark as a test target.
editorial.whats_new: NVIDIA published a guide to boosting 124B MoE inference on a single DGX Spark, and a Flare inference engine for DGX Spark appeared in an NVIDIA GitHub repo.
editorial.why_it_matters: Single-box, 128GB-class local inference is getting first-party tooling and upstream CI coverage, which makes on-prem MoE serving a more realistic option.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you target DGX Spark, benchmark Flare and the NVIDIA MoE tuning steps against your current vLLM build before committing to a serving stack.

status.detail: Hardware is shipping and NVIDIA is now publishing DGX Spark-specific inference tooling and tuning guidance.
